metrics.name: success_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of attempts that yielded a recipe (whether or not the result was already in the inventory). The game tree has ~600 valid recipes from a search space of ~145k pairs, so a uniform-random combiner would succeed at ~0.4%; humans achieve 30-50% by leveraging the inventory's empowerment structure.

metrics.name: novelty_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of attempts that yielded a novel discovery (a new element added to the inventory). Adults achieve 30-40% novelty rate.
